name: smart-doorbell
description: Sistema de campainha inteligente usando celular Android

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=frontend && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=shared
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules shared/node_modules frontend/dist backend/dist
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=backend && npm run type-check --workspace=frontend
